title: Seagrove Beach "Mia’s Place" 22 South Gulf Drive
h1: Seagrove Beach "Mia’s Place" 22 South Gulf Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $75 per day. Pool can also be cooled.- Half mile from the beach- Low-Speed Vehicle rental across the street- Large porch- Neighboring to Eastern Lake- 4 adult bikes- Local shopping and restaurants within walking distance- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Welcome to Mia's Place, a stunning 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom house nestled in the serene Eastern Lake neighborhood of Seagrove Beach, accommodating up to 10 guests. Boasting a large porch with views that invite relaxation and moments of bliss, this retreat is perfect for family and friends. The public beach access awaits a short stroll away, providing effortless entry to sandy shores and blue-green waters, making this an ideal setting for any beachside escape.The first floor of this 2-story stilted home offers a harmonious blend of comfort and style, starting with the stunning great room bathed in natural light from expansive picture windows that showcase neighborhood views and elegant hardwood floors. Experience luxury in the open living area with an oversized sectional couch and 2 armchairs facing an impressive 75" Smart TV for family movie nights. Enjoy covered deck access from the great room outfitted with a propane grill for intimate cookouts with friends and family. An adjacent dining area seats 6, while the breakfast bar seats 2 more. The kitchen has high-end appliances, featuring a 5-burner stovetop with griddle plate and oven, complemented by a beautiful custom backsplash, sleek white cabinets, and quartz countertops. When it's time to retire, guests can choose from 2 comfortable guest bedrooms on this floor, each with a king bed and private bathroom. There's a stacked washer and dryer conveniently tucked away in the hall.Discover unparalleled comfort on the second floor, where the 2 remaining bedrooms can be found—1 guest bedroom with a luxurious queen bed and a private bathroom, as well as 1 other versatile guest bedroom with a private bathroom and 2 twin beds with 2 twin trundles that are great for kids or young adults.Mia's Place embodies the essence of a seamless and memorable beach getaway. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway under the house, plus 4 complimentary adult bikes, it's easy to explore the surrounding beach communities and attractions. For beach access, head south on South Gulf Drive until reaching Eastern Lake Public Beach Access, which is a quick stroll away. Book now for an unforgettable trip!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds with Twin Trundles, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

Pool can also be cooled. - Half mile from the beach - Low-Speed Vehicle rental across the street - Large porch - Neighboring to Eastern Lake - 4 adult bikes - Local shopping and restaurants within walking distance - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Welcome to Mia's Place, a stunning 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom house nestled in the serene Eastern Lake neighborhood of Seagrove Beach, accommodating up to 10 guests. Boasting a large porch with views that invite relaxation and moments of bliss, this retreat is perfect for family and friends. The public beach access awaits a short stroll away, providing effortless entry to sandy shores and blue-green waters, making this an ideal setting for any beachside escape. The first floor of this 2-story stilted home offers a harmonious blend of comfort and style, starting with the stunning great room bathed in natural light from expansive picture windows that showcase neighborhood views and elegant hardwood floors. Experience luxury in the open living area with an oversized sectional couch and 2 armchairs facing an impressive 75" Smart TV for family movie nights. Enjoy covered deck access from the great room outfitted with a propane grill for intimate cookouts with friends and family. An adjacent dining area seats 6, while the breakfast bar seats 2 more. The kitchen has high-end appliances, featuring a 5-burner stovetop with griddle plate and oven, complemented by a beautiful custom backsplash, sleek white cabinets, and quartz countertops. When it's time to retire, guests can choose from 2 comfortable guest bedrooms on this floor, each with a king bed and private bathroom. There's a stacked washer and dryer conveniently tucked away in the hall. Discover unparalleled comfort on the second floor, where the 2 remaining bedrooms can be found—1 guest bedroom with a luxurious queen bed and a private bathroom, as well as 1 other versatile guest bedroom with a private bathroom and 2 twin beds with 2 twin trundles that are great for kids or young adults. Mia's Place embodies the essence of a seamless and memorable beach getaway. With on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway under the house, plus 4 complimentary adult bikes, it's easy to explore the surrounding beach communities and attractions. For beach access, head south on South Gulf Drive until reaching Eastern Lake Public Beach Access, which is a quick stroll away. Book now for an unforgettable trip!
